<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_587457_pear.PEAR_Utils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PEAR_Utils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var PEAR_Utils = Class.create();
PEAR_Utils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

	initialize: function () {},

	getProjectsByBusinessProfile: function (BusinessProfileId) {

		gs.info('getProjectsByBusinessProfile START')

		var BusinessProfileRequiredProjects = [];
		// 1) Business Parts attivi per BP
		var BusinessPart = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_business_part_of_app_access');
		BusinessPart.addQuery('business_profile_id', BusinessProfileId);
		// BusinessPart.addQuery('status', 'active');
		BusinessPart.query();

		while(BusinessPart.next())
		{
			// gs.info(BusinessPart.label);
			var ApplicativeAccess = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_applicative_access');
			ApplicativeAccess.addQuery("business_part_id",BusinessPart.sys_id);
			ApplicativeAccess.query();
			gs.info('getProjectsByBusinessProfile count ' + ApplicativeAccess.getRowCount())
			gs.info('getProjectsByBusinessProfile query ' + ApplicativeAccess.getEncodedQuery())			
			while(ApplicativeAccess.next())
			{
				// gs.info(ApplicativeAccess.app_id.getDisplayValue())
				var ApplicativeAccessFormat = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_app_access_format');
				ApplicativeAccessFormat.get('app_id',ApplicativeAccess.app_id);
				// gs.info("\n\nBusinessPart " + BusinessPart.label + 'ApplicativeAccess ' + ApplicativeAccess.label + 'Format ' + ApplicativeAccessFormat.format)
				// if(ApplicativeAccessFormat.format.toString().contains('prj'))
				if(ApplicativeAccessFormat.format.toString().contains('project'))
				{
					if(!BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.toString().contains(ApplicativeAccess.project_space_id.toString()))
						BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.push(ApplicativeAccess.project_space_id.toString())
				}
			}
		}

		gs.info('getProjectsByBusinessProfile BusinessProfileRequiredProjects ' + BusinessProfileRequiredProjects)
		return BusinessProfileRequiredProjects

    },

	isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile: function (BusinessProfileId) {
		gs.info('Calling isProjectRequiredByBusinessProfile')

		if (!BusinessProfileId) {
			BusinessProfileId = this.getParameter('sysparm_BusinessProfileId');
		}



		var BusinessProfileRequiredProjects = [];
		// 1) Business Parts attivi per BP
		var BusinessPart = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_business_part_of_app_access');
		BusinessPart.addQuery('business_profile_id', BusinessProfileId);
		BusinessPart.addQuery('status', 'active');
		BusinessPart.query();
		// gs.info('BusinessPart count ' + BusinessPart.getRowCount())
		while(BusinessPart.next())
		{
			// gs.info(BusinessPart.label);
			var ApplicativeAccess = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_applicative_access');
			ApplicativeAccess.addQuery("business_part_id",BusinessPart.sys_id);
			ApplicativeAccess.query();
			while(ApplicativeAccess.next())
			{
				// gs.info(ApplicativeAccess.app_id.getDisplayValue())
				var ApplicativeAccessFormat = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_app_access_format');
				ApplicativeAccessFormat.get('app_id',ApplicativeAccess.app_id);
				// gs.info("\n\nBusinessPart " + BusinessPart.label + 'ApplicativeAccess ' + ApplicativeAccess.label + 'Format ' + ApplicativeAccessFormat.format)
				if(ApplicativeAccessFormat.format.toString().contains('prj'))
				{
					if(!BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.toString().contains(ApplicativeAccess.project_space_id.toString()))
						BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.push(ApplicativeAccess.project_space_id.toString())
				}
			}
		}

		if(BusinessProfileRequiredProjects.length==0)
			return false;
		else
			return true;

    },

    type: 'PEAR_Utils'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-10-29 00:19:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>8c2d5ef647b83210c361f19f016d4365</sys_id><sys_mod_count>26</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PEAR_Utils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PEAR" source="x_587457_pear">145cb95a47fcb210c361f19f016d439b</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="PEAR">145cb95a47fcb210c361f19f016d439b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_8c2d5ef647b83210c361f19f016d4365</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-11-12 21:53:58</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
